Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu offers "Reassign lead technician".
  • Step 2: the "Reassign lead technician" dialog opens.
  • Step 3: a "Search technicians" box, then one list of technicians at {Location-A} with no grouping, each with an avatar and an "N open" count. {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} are in it. There is no "Unassigned" row.
  • Step 4: the only button is "Cancel". There is no "Reassign" or other confirm button.
  • Step 5: the dialog closes and nothing changes: {Work-order-1} stays in {Technician-A}'s column and no message shows.
  • Step 6: the menu offers "Reassign lead technician".
  • Step 7: the "Reassign lead technician" dialog opens.
  • Step 8: the dialog closes at once, with no other click, and {Work-order-1} moves to {Technician-B}'s column. The message "{Work-order-1} assigned to {Technician-B}" shows, with an "Undo" button.

Known problem (SV-11567, Open, fast follow; Undo is its own ticket, Chris Ward on SV-11524, 20 Oct 2026; seen on the QA branch sv11524 on 26 Oct 2026): the message has the right words but no "Undo" button, only a close (×), and it closes after about 2.6 seconds. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results say, Undo has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician from the board or grouped table); tickets SV-11522 (Tech View) and SV-11524 (Board View)

  • S4-R12: “The dialog offers eligible active technicians in the current location and nothing else. Unassigned is not offered there: Unassigned is the place for work orders without a lead, not a technician, and removing the lead is the menu’s Unassign action (S11-R9) or a drag to Unassigned. It follows the design: a Search technicians box, each technician with their avatar and N open count, no grouping.”
  • S4-R13: “Clicking a technician in the dialog assigns them at once; there is no confirm button, and the dialog’s only button is Cancel. When the shift-clearing prompt applies (S4-R28) it shows first, and the change is made from the prompt. Clicking the work order’s current lead closes the dialog with no change (S4-N4).”
  • S4-N4: “Selecting the current lead again leaves all assignments unchanged and produces no reassignment toast.”
  • S4-R5: “After a successful lead change on Board View or Tech View, whether by drag, the dialog or Unassign, show the design’s toast (white, with the check icon) with an Undo button. Examples: “S1-357 assigned to Esther Howard”, “S1-702 lead technician set to Ralph Edwards”, “S1-352 moved to Unassigned”. This replaces the standard success toast for these messages only.”
  • PRD change log, 19 Oct 2026: “S4-R12, S4-R13, S4-R30: Unassigned is no longer offered in the dialog (Unassign stays in the menu, S11-R9); clicking a technician assigns at once, no Reassign button; clicking the current lead closes with no change. v66.”
